data.narrative:
Still Bright, a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Jon Vardner and Professors Alan C. West and Scott Banta, has raised $18.7M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (Linamar, LNZA), though representative peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix operate across different stages and valuation tiers.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage transitions, using the $18.7M raised as a valuation proxy. This method yields an implied valuation of $47M. Peer-median comparison is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow Climate & Energy cohort; eight sector peers exist but none cluster tightly enough to produce three or more valid datapoints within narrow stage and valuation filters. Falling back to all-sector medians would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of climate-tech business models and development timelines.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, with a median of $47M. However, this range rests on a single applicable method and should be weighted accordingly. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer data at seed stage in climate tech, the company's actual progress toward Series A readiness, and market conditions affecting climate-tech fundraising since the $18.7M raise.
